INSERT INTO voice_user_profiles (user_id, name, bio, show_activity, active, updated_at, profile_updated_at, active_updated_at, timezone)
            VALUES ($1, '', $2, $3, $5, to_timestamp(0), $4, $4, $6)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
                SET bio = CASE WHEN voice_user_profiles.profile_updated_at IS NULL OR voice_user_profiles.profile_updated_at <= EXCLUDED.profile_updated_at THEN EXCLUDED.bio ELSE voice_user_profiles.bio END,
                    show_activity = CASE WHEN voice_user_profiles.profile_updated_at IS NULL OR voice_user_profiles.profile_updated_at <= EXCLUDED.profile_updated_at THEN EXCLUDED.show_activity ELSE voice_user_profiles.show_activity END,
                    timezone = CASE WHEN voice_user_profiles.profile_updated_at IS NULL OR voice_user_profiles.profile_updated_at <= EXCLUDED.profile_updated_at THEN EXCLUDED.timezone ELSE voice_user_profiles.timezone END,
                    profile_updated_at = GREATEST(voice_user_profiles.profile_updated_at, EXCLUDED.profile_updated_at),
                    active = CASE WHEN voice_user_profiles.active_updated_at <= EXCLUDED.active_updated_at THEN EXCLUDED.active ELSE voice_user_profiles.active END,
                    active_updated_at = GREATEST(voice_user_profiles.active_updated_at, EXCLUDED.active_updated_at)
